page_note: 页面为投资研究报告的"Strategic direction"章节，正文讨论高盛业务结构，中部为Exhibit 3的百分比堆叠柱状图"Historical revenue mix"，展示FY 2010A–FY 2015A六个财年六类业务收入占比。

components.evidence: each FY column is one bar split into six coloured segments labelled 13%, 19%, 35%, 21%, 5%, 7%
all six FY bars reach identical height and segment labels sum to 100% per year
no tick labels along the left edge; only faint horizontal rules and printed percentages
percentages such as "31%", "29%", "12%" printed on top of each coloured segment
two rows of legend entries "Underwriting ... Investment management" sit under the FY axis labels
light horizontal rules cross the plot; no vertical grid lines drawn
bottom segments "5%"/"7%" and "6%"/"12%" labels are squeezed into very narrow bands
the figure sits inside a blue-bordered box with the title inset into its top border

new_components.name: title_inset_in_frame_border
new_components.evidence: "Historical revenue mix" is set into a gap in the top line of the figure's border box
new_components.why_it_matters: 标题嵌入边框线中而非独立标题行，解析器可能把它当作框线注释丢失，从而使表格失去图名上下文。

new_components.name: exhibit_number_separate_from_title
new_components.evidence: "Exhibit 3" is a standalone blue heading above the framed box holding "Historical revenue mix"
new_components.why_it_matters: 编号与图名被水平分割线分成两块，取值时需同时定位两处才能完整寻址该图。

new_components.name: no_unit_text_anywhere
new_components.evidence: no "%" axis title or subtitle; scale recoverable only from the in-segment labels
new_components.why_it_matters: 单位只能由标签自身的百分号推断，若解析器丢掉%号则数值失去量纲。

difficulty_notes: 数值本身全部印在色块内（13%、31%、11% 等），读数不成问题，也无刻度轴需要插值；但36个色块中重复值极多：7% 出现四次（FY 2010A Underwriting、FY 2011A Financial advisory、FY 2011A Investing and lending、FY 2014A Financial advisory），12%、21%、25%、17% 各出现两到三次，因此任何一个值必须同时携带年份键（FY 2013A）与业务键（Underwriting）两级标签才能唯一寻址；而图上没有值轴、图例分两行置于横轴下方，解析器很容易把六个系列名与年份的对应关系打散，只输出一串裸百分数，使行列标签无法成对。

suggestions.what_to_add: pct_stacked 与 no_value_axis 组合（无值轴的百分比堆叠）
suggestions.where_to_change: 条件行中新增"堆叠且所有标签内嵌、无刻度"的样式组合，记录字段需强制输出 series×category 双键
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 有值轴 vs 完全无值轴的百分比堆叠图，比较取值命中率

suggestions.what_to_add: new_components 中的 title_inset_in_frame_border 与 exhibit_number_separate_from_title
suggestions.where_to_change: 标题样式字段：图号、图名分离，且图名嵌入边框线
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 图号与图名同处一行 vs 被分割线分离时，图名能否进入表格上下文

suggestions.where_to_change: 样式字段中标签放置策略：段高<8%时标签仍内嵌并可能重叠
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 窄段标签内嵌 vs 外移引线时的数值可读性

suggestions.what_to_add: 重复值的多键寻址要求（series+category 必须成对）
suggestions.where_to_change: 记录字段：为每个 mark 生成 (category_name, series_name) 复合键而非单值
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 含重复数值的图（如 7% 出现四次）在单键 vs 双键寻址下的评分差异
